bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
echo "DM_POSTGRES_ENV_NAMES_BEGIN"
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E "^(POSTGRES|PG|DATABASE)" | sort' || true
echo DM_POSTGRES_ENV_NAMES_END
echo DM_POSTGRES_MOUNTS_BEGIN
docker inspect --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}}{{println}}{{end}}' "$pg" | grep -Ei 'secret|pg|postgres|data' | head -n 20
echo DM_POSTGRES_MOUNTS_END
echo DM_POSTGRES_AUTH_TYPES
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -tA -c "SHOW hba_file"' | xargs -r -I{} docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'grep -vE "^[[:space:]]*(#|$)" "{}" | sed -E "s/[[:space:]]+/ /g" | head -n 18'
echo DM_EXISTING_IMAGES
docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -E '^node:|create-videobot|gace.*videobot' | head -n 12 || true
echo DM_DOCKER_BUILDX=$(docker buildx version >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo YES || echo NO)
echo DM_PG_PROBE_END
